diagnostic.claim_failure: Install follows ownership installer and is covered by existing make_hook failure counter and community_abort(-37) before readiness publication. On rejected claim no diagnostic hook is installed or invoked.

diagnostic.runtime_condition: Diagnostic use only if stable uninstrumented startup still misses slot7. It is not an acceptance artifact; final acceptance must rerun the uninstrumented exact candidate.

limits: No exact causal predicate or product fix established. NativeUSB suppression, local-slot borrowing and fixture-only dismissal are not proposed. Raw firmware decompilation remains local/ignored.
